messages:
sara (People Ops): New Gifts & Anti-Bribery policy launching Tue 2026-04-07. Need handbook update, microlearning (20m), and manager attestations. Tracker: docs/anti-bribery-tracker
 tom (Recruiting): Noted. Do we add clause to offers/contractor SOWs? cc @olivia
 lee (Legal): Yes. Short clause ready; will paste into tracker. Applies to employees, contractors, vendors. Exemptions require manager+legal approval.
 handbook-bot: Handbook v3.2 posted: /policies/anti-bribery-gifts (sections updated: Gifts, Conflicts, Escalation)
 olivia (People Ops): Rollout plan: 1) Publish in handbook. 2) Launch 1-slide microlearning + 3 quiz Qs. 3) Managers attest per-team by 2026-04-21. 4) Nightly CSV exports to GCS.
 dev (Eng Manager): Managers must sign attestations or can delegate? Also please provide per-team CSV so leads can follow up.
 sara (People Ops): Managers must attest; acting manager can sign if they cover and cc original manager. CSV path: gs://redwood-hr-exports/antibribery/antibribery-completions-<YYYYMMDD>.csv
 tom (Recruiting): Onboarding note: "All hires must complete Anti-Bribery & Gifts training within 30 days." OK?
 lee (Legal): OK. For short-contractors (<30d): "Contractor to acknowledge policy; manager tracks where feasible"
 olivia (People Ops): Manager attestation form fields: manager_email, team_name, attestation_date, total_headcount, completed_count, notes. Auto-populate team and headcount from HRIS where possible.
 dev (Eng Manager): Can we get weekly digests with non-completers?
 sara (People Ops): Yes 0weekly digests to managers + ops leads; nightly CSVs for ops.
 lee (Legal): Note: gifts under $50 must still be logged for contracted vendors. Add examples to handbook.
 olivia (People Ops): Will add Examples subsection and quiz items covering <$50 rule.
 tom (Recruiting): Added onboarding checklist item; new hires get training on day 1 access.
 sara (People Ops): Timeline: Thu EOD announce + calendar invites, Fri form live, Mon training opens, 2026-04-21 attestations due.
 dev (Eng Manager): Please add manager FAQ note in weekly update.
 olivia (People Ops): Will do. Contact: hr-compliance@redwood.ai.
 lee (Legal): I'll run a 30-min manager Q&A Tue 10am PT.
 sara (People Ops): Final tasks: Lee paste policy text in tracker, Olivia build microlearning + quiz, Tom update offer/onboarding copy, Ops configure CSV exports. I'll post company announcement Thurs. Flag blockers here. :raised_hands:
